dct_description_sm: This file contains data collected during the national survey related to Phase 3A of the Dialogue on Drinking campaign. The two questions concerning the respondents' coping/celebrating methods were dropped from this and the preceding survey in March 1978. Analysis revealed similar consumption patterns as the previous surveys although the consumption percentages more closely resembled Phase 1 - November and December 1976.
dct_title_s: Alcohol Consumption in Canada: A National Study, 1978/11
